# Repository Documentation

This knowledge base is generated by docify-repo. It is the primary entry point for
maintainers, onboarding engineers, API consumers, and AI coding assistants.

## Documents

- [Codebase Info](codebase_info.md) — Scanner metadata, detected languages, manifests, and the component hierarchy.
- [Components](components.md) — Catalog of components with purpose and responsibilities.
- [Architecture](architecture.md) — Architectural responsibilities and boundaries per component.
- [Interfaces](interfaces.md) — APIs, events, commands, and integration points per component.
- [Data Models](data_models.md) — Entities, schemas, fields, relationships, and class diagrams.
- [Workflows](workflows.md) — Runtime and development flows with flow and sequence diagrams.
- [Dependencies](dependencies.md) — External and internal dependencies per component.
- [Review Notes](review_notes.md) — Deterministic scanner notes and model-reported review gaps.
